menu.prompt: Gentle acoustic folk instrumental for a cozy nature board game: warm fingerpicked guitar, soft flute and light hand percussion, morning in a mountain valley, calm and inviting. 90 seconds, seamless loop. No vocals. Make 2 versions (a and b).

main.prompt: Gentle acoustic folk instrumental for a cozy nature board game: relaxed thinking music, light piano and mandolin over a soft pad, steady tempo, unobtrusive so players can concentrate. 2 minutes, seamless loop. No vocals. Make 2 versions (a and b).

victory.prompt: Gentle acoustic folk instrumental for a cozy nature board game: short bright fanfare on fiddle and acoustic guitar with a cheerful flute flourish, sunlit and triumphant. 8 to 12 seconds, ends cleanly. No vocals. Make 2 versions (a and b).

defeat.prompt: Gentle acoustic folk instrumental for a cozy nature board game: short soft ending on solo cello and harp, gentle and hopeful rather than sad, like dusk rain. 6 to 10 seconds, ends cleanly. No vocals. Make 2 versions (a and b).
